description: This file defines the RuntimeClass API objects for Kubernetes, including the RuntimeClass struct, Overhead, Scheduling, and RuntimeClassList, used for managing container runtime classes in a Kubernetes cluster.

classes.name: RuntimeClass
classes.description: Defines a class of container runtime supported in the cluster, specifying handler, overhead, and scheduling constraints.

classes.name: Overhead
classes.description: Represents resource overhead associated with running a pod for a RuntimeClass.

classes.name: Scheduling
classes.description: Specifies scheduling constraints for nodes supporting a RuntimeClass, including nodeSelector and tolerations.
